title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
summary: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
summary: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
summary: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
summary: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
summary: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.
